worldOfNukesBeginnerGuide.title: World of Nukes Beginner Guide
worldOfNukesBeginnerGuide.subtitle: Build Your First Island and Grow Your Country
worldOfNukesBeginnerGuide.intro: A successful start in World of Nukes depends on balancing expansion, construction, military preparation, and defense. Build a stable resource base first, then expand your island while preparing missiles and defensive systems before enemy attacks begin.

steps.title: Establish the First Camp
actions: Place the initial camp and organize the available island space.
Prioritize the structures needed to generate and manage resources.
Keep the first layout compact so later expansion remains efficient.
steps.priority: Secure basic resources before investing heavily in military systems.

steps.title: Expand the Island
steps.objective: Turn the camp into a functioning country
actions: Use collected resources to construct additional buildings.
Expand outward in an organized pattern instead of scattering structures.
Reserve open space for missile systems, anti-air defenses, and shields.
steps.priority: Plan the island around both production and protection.

steps.title: Deploy Missile Systems
actions: Build and place missile-related structures when the required resources are available.
Learn the launch interface before committing to an attack.
Select enemy targets carefully and avoid wasting limited offensive resources.
steps.priority: Treat missile deployment as a strategic decision rather than an automatic action.

steps.title: Add Early Defenses
actions: Place anti-air defenses around important buildings and likely attack routes.
Use shields to protect the core of the island from nuclear strikes.
Continue improving the economy so defensive coverage can expand with the country.
steps.priority: Protect the island core before extending defenses to less important areas.

quickTips: Grow your economy first — every missile, jet, and defense is funded by steady income.
Reserve open land early so military structures never force an awkward rebuild.
Scout a rival island before launching to make every strike count.
Rebuild damaged structures right after an attack instead of stockpiling for later.

worldOfNukesBestNukesMissiles.title: World of Nukes Best Nukes & Missiles
worldOfNukesBestNukesMissiles.subtitle: Nukes and Missiles: Launching and Target Selection
worldOfNukesBestNukesMissiles.intro: World of Nukes uses missile and nuclear attack systems to let players select enemy targets and launch offensive strikes. Weapon effectiveness depends on availability, unlock requirements, target value, and the player's ability to support attacks with a strong island economy and defenses.

tiers.strategy: Review the enemy island before launching, prioritize valuable targets, and avoid attacks that leave your own island undefended.

worldOfNukesBestDefenseStrategy.title: World of Nukes Best Defense Strategy
worldOfNukesBestDefenseStrategy.subtitle: Protect Your Island from Incoming Nuclear Strikes
worldOfNukesBestDefenseStrategy.intro: A strong defense in World of Nukes protects the island's most important structures first and expands coverage as the country grows. Anti-air defenses help respond to incoming attacks, while shields provide vital protection for the island core against nuclear strikes.

options.title: Anti-Air Defense
strengths: Provides active protection against incoming threats.
Can be positioned near important structures and likely attack paths.
Supports the island against repeated enemy pressure.
options.placement: Place anti-air defenses where their coverage protects the central base, resource structures, and major military buildings.

options.title: Island Shield
options.role: Protect the island core from nuclear strikes
strengths: Adds a defensive layer against large-scale nuclear attacks.
Helps preserve critical buildings during enemy offensives.
Becomes more valuable as the island grows and contains more investments.
options.placement: Keep the shield close to the most valuable section of the island and build the surrounding layout around its protective purpose.

options.title: Layered Defense Layout
options.role: Combine defensive systems for maximum survival
strengths: Protects the core before outer structures.
Reduces the risk of losing all important buildings to one attack.
Allows the defensive network to expand together with the country.
options.placement: Use inner protection for the core and key buildings, outer anti-air coverage for exposed areas, and reserve space for future defensive upgrades.

worldOfNukesIslandBuilding.intro: A strong island combines economic growth, construction efficiency, and defensive readiness. Begin with the buildings that support reliable income, then expand your infrastructure and upgrade military capabilities as your island develops.

steps.title: Establish the Core Settlement
steps.description: Begin by developing the essential structures that allow your island to generate resources and support future expansion. Keep the initial layout organized so important buildings remain easy to access and upgrade.
priorities: Secure a reliable source of income
Build the basic structures required for progression
Leave room for defensive and military expansion

steps.title: Strengthen the Economy
steps.description: Prioritize upgrades that improve income generation and help fund construction. A stable economy allows you to recover faster, purchase military assets, and maintain a steady development pace.
priorities: Upgrade income-producing buildings before optional structures
Reinvest earnings into buildings that improve long-term growth
Avoid spending all resources on military assets too early

priorities: Improve the island's capacity to support advanced facilities

priorities: Prepare defenses before launching major attacks

worldOfNukesJetsWarships.title: World of Nukes Jets & Warships Guide
worldOfNukesJetsWarships.subtitle: Master Jets, Warships, and Island Attacks
worldOfNukesJetsWarships.intro: Jets and warships provide different approaches to island warfare. Air units offer speed and flexible attack angles, while naval forces provide sustained pressure from the surrounding waters. Use both systems together to make attacks more effective.

units.title: Jets
units.description: Jets are designed for rapid movement and aerial combat. Use them to approach targets quickly, pressure exposed areas, and reposition before opponents can respond.
tactics: Use speed to control the distance from enemy defenses
Attack vulnerable targets instead of wasting time against heavily protected positions
Return to a safe position after completing an attack run
units.bestFor: Rapid strikes, mobile defense, and attacking exposed island structures

units.title: Warships
units.description: Warships operate from the water and provide a durable platform for attacking or supporting operations against rival islands.
tactics: Use naval positioning to maintain pressure around enemy islands
Coordinate ship attacks with air operations
Avoid exposing a warship unnecessarily when the target is heavily defended
units.bestFor: Sustained attacks, coastal pressure, and supporting island assaults

units.title: Island Assaults
units.description: Attacking a rival island is most effective when vehicle roles are combined. Use mobility, range, and timing to create openings instead of sending every unit directly into enemy defenses.
tactics: Scout the target before committing your strongest vehicles
Use jets for speed and warships for sustained pressure
Prioritize economic and strategic structures during an assault
units.bestFor: Coordinated attacks against developed rival nations

units.title: Defensive Vehicle Operations
units.description: Vehicles are also valuable for defending your own island. Keep appropriate units available to respond to incoming attacks and protect the buildings that drive your economy and progression.
tactics: Maintain a defensive response force instead of committing every vehicle offensively
Use air and naval units to cover different attack routes
Rebuild and replace losses before launching another major operation
units.bestFor: Counterattacks, emergency defense, and protecting high-value structures

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about World of Nukes

questions.question: What is World of Nukes?
questions.answer: World of Nukes is a Roblox nuclear warfare strategy tycoon by Build. Defend. Nuke. You start with a small island camp, grow it into a powerful military nation, deploy missiles and nukes, fly jets, command warships, and attack rival islands while defending your own.

questions.question: Is World of Nukes free to play?
questions.answer: Yes. World of Nukes is free to play on Roblox. The game offers optional gamepasses such as VIP, Offline Tycoon, Early Warning Radar, and Quick Rebuild that add convenience and extra benefits, and every core system is playable without them.

questions.question: How many players can join one World of Nukes server?
questions.answer: Each World of Nukes server holds up to 7 players. That keeps island warfare personal: every rival nation nearby is run by a real player building, expanding, and launching attacks of their own.

questions.question: How do I get free rewards in World of Nukes?
questions.answer: Join the official World of Nukes Roblox community and keep an eye on in-game notices. Community membership is the primary way to claim free rewards, and any current redeem codes are shown through the game's official channels and redemption interface.

questions.question: What should I build first in World of Nukes?
questions.answer: Start with income-producing structures in a compact layout, then expand outward in an organized pattern. Reserve open space for missile systems, anti-air defenses, and shields so your island can grow into a military power without constant rebuilding.

questions.question: How do I defend my island in World of Nukes?
questions.answer: Layer your defenses. Place anti-air systems near important buildings and likely attack routes, keep a shield around the island core to blunt nuclear strikes, and keep your economy strong enough to rebuild and expand coverage as the country grows.
